title: Main-branch write containment and safe research scheduler boundaries

decisions.decision: Treat the unsigned main cross-analysis refresh at 03:51:40 UTC as a repository write whose causal workflow remains unknown; do not revert it or infer an actor beyond the commit metadata.

PR #1392's read-only cross-analysis and accuracy changes are useful but insufficient for a strict no-main-write policy because scheduler-tick still writes schedule_queue.jsonl to main and retains contents:write/actions:write.
Do not merge PR #1390 separately from #1392 without overlap/base reconciliation; #1392 contains the narrower scheduler allowlist and has a current-main base.
Do not expand the scheduler allowlist to arbitrary XRP workflows until an exact-commit, read-only workflow_dispatch contract is implemented, bounded to the research branch and expected SHA.
Keep PR #1393 live Morpho API ingestion and schedule inactive until explicit review/approval; its mocked core suite passed but no live provider request has been executed.
Preserve main, open PRs, research branches, queue state and historical artifacts. No reset, clean, stash, overwrite, force-push or merge.
